assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Square ABCD (blue) and its image A'B'C'D' (red dashed) after a quarter-turn about P; the swept region is bounded by arcs of radius 2, sqrt6, 2 and sqrt2 about P and by four short straight pieces, and is split into four sectors and four darker triangles with apex P.

difficulty_rationale: The swept region has to be described exactly: one must see which vertex arcs and which pieces of the initial and final squares form its boundary, and then add four sectors and four triangles.
